cases.question: Twelve claims are pending for the same reason. Quote the line that computes how many ids are left out of the listed ids.
cases.answer_format: Also return hidden_count, the integer shown after "and" in the message for that reason.

cases.question: The anchors worker fails while the hook handles an edit to a tracked file. Quote the hook line that selects the generic unknown-target warning instead of a path-specific one.
A batch holds one claim with valid supporting evidence plus an observation that no evidence_for record uses. Quote the line that rejects the whole batch for this.

A claim has exactly two applicable relations at the query scope and revision: S (supports, event s, observation o-s) and W (inconclusive, event w, observation o-w, resolves ["S"]). Quote the line that returns the assessment.
cases.answer_format: Also return result as an object with a status string and a sorted evidence_ids array of strings.

cases.question: A pending batch file is larger than 16 MiB. Quote the line that rejects it before its contents are read.
A publication batch contains a record whose id already exists in the store. Quote the line that throws for it when the batch is merged.
